note: Comfortably passes the exclusion criterion — weights, cycling, swimming and Pilates on a settled routine, happy with his own muscle mass and diet, nowhere near deconditioned or gym-averse. He also fits the good-to-great shape in spirit, wanting incremental flexibility rather than rescue ('I just want to sort of maintain my level of fitness'), though he is nearer preservation than improvement. 'income' fails on his own account: a six-month unpaid sabbatical begins three days after the call and he says 'I just have to be wise with money.' 'neglected_health' fails in the opposite direction from the usual case — health is the area he has attended to most, with an MRI, an arthroscopy, an ongoing surgical relationship, daily stretching and electrostimulation. What he has is a managed orthopaedic condition, not neglect. 'successful' could not be assessed at all: the rep never asked what he does for a living, so occupation is unknown on the transcript, which is itself the finding — the ICP's headline criterion went unmeasured on a call that reached a price quote.
